description: Opus DD unit B26: Mold Breaker Excadrill Roars Snorlax out and Gyarados is dragged in while the Roar is still active (`clearActiveMove()` comes after the phazing step). Intimidate is not breakable, so it activates; its drop on Excadrill's ally Kingler runs TryBoost with Kingler's breakable Hyper Cutter suppressed (`suppressingAbility`: the target is not the Roar's user), so both Excadrill and Kingler lose one Attack stage.
